pairs.subject: voice-interview-fidelity
pairs.evidence: app/api/interview/connect/route.ts:512 Connect sends a per-job ASR keyword-bias list to the served session, and no null-audio control was run on it; the floor list it pads with (asr-keywords.mjs BASE_ASR_KEYWORDS) also boosts both 'React' and 'Rust', a pair the code's own comment says the recogniser swaps, so the step meant to fix substituted skills can add phantom skills unmeasured.

techniques.evidence: app/api/interview/connect/route.ts:512 Vocabulary biasing ships with no null-audio control. A repo-wide grep found no phantom/null-audio check. The confusable pair React/Rust is boosted together without a measured decision.

app/api/interview/connect/route.ts:439 The candidate's language is passed into the provider connect config. openai.ts:207-209 then sets the transcription language, so the setting is config and not only prompt text. Per-turn drift detection lives in app/_lib/voice/language-lock.ts, outside this context.

app/api/interview/complete/route.ts:162 The persistence cap keeps head and tail and adds an in-band omission marker (interview-transcript.ts:97-110). It cuts on turn boundaries and never drops the final turns. The split is even, which the technique allows.

app/api/interview/complete/route.ts:424 Scoring is gated only on status, candidate mode and a non-empty transcript. No entity-restricted error rate or deletion check runs before the scorecard is built. The lexicon exists only in the interview-sim harness.

pairs.subject: voice-interview-fidelity
pairs.evidence: packages/voice-stt/src/providers/whisper-cpp.ts:204 The on-device whisper.cpp adapter, which its own header says is built for first-round interview audio, runs the recogniser with no speech-detection (VAD) gate and drops nothing that lands in non-speech stretches, so text written over a candidate's silence comes back as transcript.

techniques.evidence: packages/voice-stt/src/providers/whisper-cpp.ts:204 Step 5 (do not transcribe what was not detected as speech) is not realised. Neither the adapter nor useStt has VAD or silence gating.

packages/voice-stt/src/providers/whisper-cpp.ts:197 The language goes into the engine config (-l, and language_code on AssemblyAI). An English-only model asked for another language is refused rather than returning fluent wrong-language text.
